typography.installation_instructions: Add Google Fonts imports in index.css: @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;0,500;0,600;0,700;1,400&family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;500&family=IBM+Plex+Sans:wght@300;400;500;600&display=swap'); Apply to tailwind config.

visual_enhancers.borders: Expose the skeleton. Use 1px solid borders (border-black/15) to separate sections, articles, and grid columns. This mimics print newspaper layouts.
visual_enhancers.border_radius: rounded-none everywhere. Sharp corners enforce the print editorial aesthetic.
visual_enhancers.shadows: No soft drop shadows. Use 1px solid borders or hard offset shadows (e.g., 4px 4px 0px #1C1B1A) for interactive elements if necessary, but prefer flat design.
visual_enhancers.textures: Apply a very subtle noise overlay to the background to simulate paper grain. This can be an SVG filter or a tiny repeatable noise PNG with opacity 0.03.

layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Sections should have massive padding (py-24 or py-32). Inner gaps should contrast heavily (either very wide gap-16 or tight 1px borders with zero gap).
layouts.grids: Use 'The Swiss Grid' approach. 12-column grid. Do not center everything; use asymmetry. E.g., Hero text spans 7 columns, image spans 5.

sections.header: Sticky nav with solid background (bg-[#F4F3EF]) and bottom border. Do not use transparent backgrounds.
sections.hero: Split layout. Left: Massive H1 and a mono-spaced dateline. Right: Editorial photo. Separated by a vertical border.
sections.news_feed: List format, not cards. Title, snippet, and metadata (country/category). Each item separated by a horizontal border (border-b border-black/15).
sections.city_spotlight: Grid of tall, portrait-oriented images (aspect-[3/4]). Text tightly aligned underneath. Images should be black-and-white by default, turning full color on hover.
sections.remote_work_tips: A smaller bento box or columned text section mimicking a magazine's 'back page' or advice column.

motion.interactions: Keep it classy and minimal. No bouncy animations.
motion.hover_states: Images: Convert from grayscale to full color. Text: Underline expands or color shifts to terracotta. Buttons: Invert background and text color.
motion.transitions: Use specific properties: transition-colors duration-300 ease-in-out or transition-[filter] duration-500 ease-out.

accessibility.contrast: Text contrast is extremely high (dark charcoal on off-white). Hover states must maintain readability.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use pure HTML and Tailwind CSS for layouts. Avoid using pre-built Shadcn UI layout components (like Cards) for the main structure, as they enforce rounded corners and shadows that break the print editorial aesthetic.
If using Javascript components (.js/.jsx format), ensure they follow the design system precisely. Do NOT use .tsx files as the project environment expects Javascript.
Implement the 'Swiss Grid' pattern by utilizing 'border-collapse' on containers and applying 'border-b' or 'border-r' utilities to grid items to draw literal lines between content.
Never use the Inter font. Strictly adhere to Cormorant Garamond for headings and IBM Plex for body/metadata.
All navigation and dropdown elements must have a solid background color (e.g. bg-[#F4F3EF]). Transparent headers over scrolling content are forbidden.
Images should ideally lack rounded corners (rounded-none). The aesthetic is strict print magazine, not modern SaaS.

Add the following to index.css to implement the font family: @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;0,500;0,600;0,700;1,400&family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;500&family=IBM+Plex+Sans:wght@300;400;500;600&display=swap');
Update tailwind.config.js to extend the font families: { sans: ['IBM Plex Sans', 'sans-serif'], serif: ['Cormorant Garamond', 'serif'], mono: ['IBM Plex Mono', 'monospace'] }.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g. 'transition: all').
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e., do not add '.App { text-align: center; }' in the css file.
Never use placeholder URLs (via.placeholder.com). Use the URLs provided in the image_urls array.
test_attributes: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case representing their role.
